steps.observable_result: The current WorkflowHub session has read the portable package and original requirement, and established the one current OI outline before research; the existing writer appends this step's outcome to the same decision-log.md.
The initial OI framework nodes, fixed categories, scope, uncertainty, and non-goals are written into decision-log.md; the existing writer appends this step's outcome to the same decision-log.md.
Talk round 1 uses real ask -> wait -> user reply -> resume and records the answer, consequences, risks, and outcome in the same decision-log.md.
Needed research is completed or honestly marked unavailable or skipped, with conclusions in decision-log.md; the existing writer appends this step's outcome to the same decision-log.md.
Talk round 2 records the user's actual direction, scope, non-goals, consequences, and risks in the same decision-log.md; no review runs here.

One independent direction advice fact consumes the current OI `convergence_outline` questions-only projection after Talk round 2 and before Talk round 3; it is advice only, not provider pass, and the existing writer appends the outcome to the same decision-log.md. Retain the actual canonical attempt_ref/result_ref/report_ref from the existing review request writer; safeReviewFacts consumes the matching review evidence input. Missing or unavailable stays explicit and never becomes an empty successful result. Use the actual canonical result ref when available; when the review is unavailable, consume its canonical attempt ref. These are alternative evidence paths, not a requirement to produce both.

Talk round 3 uses the real reply/resume seam with the explicit red/blue direction-review finding dispute list and debate unresolved items to resolve contradictions, key assumptions, and remaining risks, then appends its outcome to the same decision-log.md.

Grill runs after direction advice and Talk round 3 as interactive thinking only: one batch of independent frontier questions, real ask -> wait -> user reply -> resume, no review fact; its outcome is appended to the same decision-log.md.
decision-log.md contains the original requirement, key facts, decision, rationale, risks, and deferred work; the existing writer appends this step's outcome to the same decision-log.md.

One independent detail advice fact is recorded after Grill and the decision draft; it checks the current terminal fields for each OI and remains advice only, not provider pass. Before approval, evaluate whether any remaining dispute is direction-level or acceptance-impacting: only then run conditional Talk round 4; otherwise the main agent repairs implementation-level findings directly and registers the disposition. The outcome is appended to the same decision-log.md. Retain the actual canonical attempt_ref/result_ref/report_ref from the existing review request writer; safeReviewFacts consumes the matching review evidence input. Missing or unavailable stays explicit and never becomes an empty successful result. Use the actual canonical result ref when available; when the review is unavailable, consume its canonical attempt ref. These are alternative evidence paths, not a requirement to produce both.

The user's actual confirmation is recorded in decision-log.md; before the existing immutable interaction aggregate is assembled, OI items needing a decision are shown as grouped plain-language options with consequences and risks, and the selected disposition, visible group/batch, and interaction proof are recorded; the existing writer appends the reply or rejection to the same decision-log.md, with no inferred answer, no extra delivery-state object, and no extra delivery-status object. Ordinary direction confirmation binds the approved decision-log content scope; downstream material refinement preserves it, while a changed direction requires a new real reply.

The existing spec-analyze profile checks the original requirement, authenticated requirement projection, current decision-log semantics, complete Grill and review facts, final confirmation, interaction aggregate, boundaries, and all current evidence; valid gaps are repaired in this stage and a plain-language six-field summary is produced before handoff. If repair changes the decision, confirmation and aggregate are refreshed in this same task. The existing writer appends this outcome to the same decision-log.md.

The current WorkflowHub session gives a plain-language handoff covering decision, reasons, risks, and next stage; the existing writer appends the final outcome to the same decision-log.md and the comment is notification, not a gate.

runStageEndReflection 消费本次认证 stage outcome 与 v2 judgment，返回实际 immutable ref/sha256；reflection_key 是语义身份，sha256 是原件 bytes hash。A/A 复用首次原件，B 写新 ref；缺判断或执行失败保持 unavailable/failed，原 stage 错误保留，复盘不阻断同 task 修复。
